note_text: PWD received the nh-48 culvert repair estimate proposal and registered it in the file system.
Section Officer assigned the file to E302 to examine the proposal, estimate, and supporting documents.
Technical examination completed. Quantity, site details, estimate, and supporting documents were checked.
PWD forwarded the file to Finance for budget availability and financial concurrence.
Finance requested the detailed rate analysis because the estimate did not show the basis for the proposed rates.
PWD attached the detailed rate analysis and updated the estimate with the supporting calculation.
Finance found one more missing supporting document and returned the file to PWD for correction before concurrence.
PWD supplied the additional document and corrected the file so Finance could continue the concurrence process.
